  transition: 0.5s;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: pointer;

.box:hover {
  transform: perspective(500px) rotateY(15deg);
  text-shadow: -6px 3px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  box-shadow: -2px 0 0 5px rgba(35, 255, 218, 0.8);
}

  content: '';

  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;

}
